children: T3 Defense announced a $1.3 million purchase order for engineered power-generation systems supporting European air-defense production.
Rimon, T3 Defense’s wholly owned subsidiary, received a purchase order of approximately $1.3 million.
Order is for engineered power-generation systems built to prime contractor specs for a European production line.
This is Rimon’s first purchase order tied to European air-defense production, expanding its market footprint.
Rimon’s YTD revenue was ~$5.25M as of July 31, 2026, exceeding full-year 2025 revenue; backlog was ~$2.1M before this order.
